description.en: Gives a side of the next skill scene a fighting spirit: it writes the entry <side>_AVATAR (e.g. ATK_AVATAR) in the skill settings table. It calls CMND_SETUP_SKL_SQ_AVATAR(_side, 1, _avatarID).
Side of the skill scene: "ATK" (attacking side) or "DEF" (defending side).

examples.case: Spirits on both sides (real usage, from ev42019997.nut)
